plain2 and plain4 are trimmed real Claude stream-json transcripts from the synthetic add-function tasks in scratchpad/edit-exp. Only tool calls/results and file-result metadata are retained; task paths are relative.

edge-cases is hand authored for prior Reads, Edit errors, replace_all, MultiEdit, known and unknown Write provenance, recovered and unrecoverable overwrites, long files/diffs, result-provided hunks, shell writes, and inert HTML content.
